newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui to invest in Aucnet's U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui to invest in Aucnet's U.S. unit.

text.p: Japanese auctioneer Aucnet Inc said on Monday it had agreed with trading company Mitsui and Co Ltd to jointly buy new shares to be issued by Aucnet's wholly owned U.S. subsidiary.
The U.S. unit, currently capitalised at $6.2 million, will issue new shares worth about $22.23 million to increase its capital, Aucnet said in a statement.
Aucnet will buy $19.23 million worth of the new shares while Mitsui will buy $3 million worth, the statement said.
After the capital increase, the subsidiary will use $24.28 million of the capital to wipe out its accumulated losses, Aucnet said.
The unit will then be left with capital of $4.15 million, with Aucnet owning 51 percent and Mitsui 49 percent, the statement said.
Aucnet is also involved in the information services business.
